title: 第七章 使者第八章 法则第九章 火种
content_zh:
旅行向来不是他喜欢的工作。自打成为冒险者，他就盼望有一天能摆脱日夜颠倒、奔波不休的生活。结果等他脱离佣兵团，这个愿望也不算完全实现。
几天前他才到威尼华兹出差，配合高塔的巡察使者“例行维护”。一路上他紧张得要命，担心青之使的下场落在自己头上。这可不是我选修魔文学的本意。当他还没离开总部时，他就怀疑高塔根本不在乎他学什么。而在后来的工作中，他的怀疑得到了证实。
只有老同学来询问情况。埃兹把猫脸花捏在手上，“谢天谢地，我还活得好好的。”
“不管怎样，别在其他人面前说这话。你一点儿风险都不用冒，海恩斯。你的上司就是成功的保障。”对面传来回应。
“成功不等于安全。问我的话，大部分危险来自于他。”
“你招惹他了？”
“那当然，现在我的尸体正在和你报平安呢。”埃兹没好气地说，“我甚至没见着他。使者用不着更换矩梯，他结束后直接离开了伊士曼。而我！”声音难以克制地拔高。“我还得到铁爪城和王党收尾外交部的破事！”
“从南到北。王国景色如何？”
“反正你的梦中情人决不会喜欢。”
“说实话？我不知道全天下她喜欢哪里。最近她传来回信，写明要在沼泽地住一个月。”
“让她来外交部，工作就能当成爱好搞定。”
“你不认为工作和个人生活应该分开看吗？”
“什么意思？”埃兹没明白。
“罗玛和萨宾娜打碎了坐标，我只能求你帮忙。”
埃兹皱起眉：“天文室的坐标？我能帮上什么？”
“白之使可以。”
晴天霹雳。“他回来了？”
“这由不得我，伙计。我只能提前通知你一声——”
“我告诉你，拉森，这绝不可能！你根本想象不到我在那个疯子的手底下遭受了怎样的折磨，你以为我会再来一次……什么？他要求的？”埃兹抬起袖子，擦了擦脸。
“你是驻守者，又对魔文和魔药学有涉猎，没有更好的人选了。”对面忽然话锋一转，“这两个任务以接待巡察使者优先，坐标的事如果你乐意，可以跟他提。”

“……你是不是打算借这回事让我再去一次王都？”
“怎么可能？只是顺路……”
“给你那两个捅娄子的小兔崽子擦屁股？”
“你知道，我没法离开高塔。”
“那就把麻烦限制在高塔范围内！我受够了，拉森。”
“帮帮忙，老兄。如果你实在抽不出时间，切斯特有空么？”
“回头再提。”不管怎么说，拉森的私人请求还好商量，外交部使者的意愿可不是他们能够左右的。为自己的性命考虑，埃兹必须打探清楚：“我们的使者大人走到哪儿了？还有多少时间？”
“他已经抵达了四叶城。你忘了吗，海恩斯？他掌握着星之隙。”
“……当心，拉森，将来你在我这里喝的每一杯酒都可能掺着胶水。”埃兹将传话的三色堇捏成了碎片。软弱的威胁，他心想，占星师多半会清楚自己哪天身体不适。谁让我没这个本事。
但等他兢兢业业地开始上班，才意识到其中的难点：要在四叶城里寻找一个外地人，难度不逊于大海捞针。根据埃兹的了解，他要接待的家伙向来不会分辨车站的指示牌……诸神在上，看来我非要走遍四叶城的每一条公交线不可。当埃兹重新长出一朵猫脸花时，心里冒出了这个绝望的念头。
……
“地毯？”
content_en:
Traveling has never been his favorite job. Ever since he became an adventurer, he has been looking forward to one day getting rid of the life of endless running around day and night. As a result, when he left the mercenary group, this wish was not fully realized.
He was on a business trip to Venevoise just a few days ago to cooperate with the tower's patrol messenger for "routine maintenance." He was extremely nervous along the way, worried that the fate of the Green Envoy would befall him. This was not my original intention to take the magic literature elective. Even before he left the headquarters, he suspected that the tower didn't care what he learned. In subsequent work, his suspicions were confirmed.
Only old classmates came to ask about the situation. Eze held the cat-face flower in his hand, "Thank God, I'm still alive and well."
"No matter what, don't say this in front of other people. You don't have to take any risks, Haynes. Your boss is the guarantee of success." came the response from the other side.
"Success does not equal safety. If you ask me, most of the danger comes from him."
"Did you provoke him?"
"Of course, now my body is reporting to you that it is safe." Eze said angrily, "I didn't even see him. The messenger didn't need to change the ladder, he left Eastman directly after he was done. And I!" The voice rose uncontrollably. "I also got Iron Claw City and the Royal Party to finish off the affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs!"
"From south to north. How is the view of the kingdom?"
"The girl of your dreams won't like it anyway."
"Honestly? I don't know where in the world she likes it. She recently sent a reply saying that she would live in the swamp for a month."
"Let her come to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and she can do her job as a hobby."
“Don’t you think work and personal life should be kept separate?”
"What do you mean?" Eze didn't understand.
"Roma and Sabina broke the coordinates. I can only ask for your help."
Eze frowned: "The coordinates of the astronomy room? How can I help?"
"Shibai can do it."
A bolt from the blue. "He's back?"
"It's not up to me, man. All I can do is give you a heads up—"
"I tell you, Larsen, this is absolutely impossible! You can't even imagine the torture I suffered at the hands of that madman. Do you think I will do it again... What? Did he ask for it?" Eze raised his sleeves and wiped his face.
"You are a garrison, and you are also involved in magic writing and potion science. There is no better candidate." The other person suddenly changed the subject. "These two tasks have priority over receiving the patrol envoys. If you are willing, you can mention the coordinates to him."
"...Are you planning to use this incident to make me go to the Royal Capital again?"
"How is that possible? I was just passing by..."
"Wiping the butts of those two little bastards of yours?"
"You know, I can't leave the tower."
"Then keep the trouble within the confines of the tower! I've had enough, Larson."
"Help, man. If you really can't spare the time, is Chester available?"
"We'll bring it up later." In any case, Larson's personal request can still be negotiated, and the wishes of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs envoy are not something they can control. For the sake of his own life, Eze must find out: "Where has our messenger gone? How much time do we have?"
"He has arrived at Yotsuba City. Did you forget, Haynes? He controls the Star Gap."
"...Be careful, Larsen, every glass of wine you drink at my place in the future may be laced with glue." Ez crushed the pansy that was sending the message into pieces. The threat of weakness, he thought, the astrologer would probably know when he was unwell. Who told me not to have this ability?
But when he started working conscientiously, he realized the difficulty: finding an outsider in Siye City was as difficult as finding a needle in a haystack. According to Ez's knowledge, the guy he was going to receive never knew how to distinguish the signs at the station... By the gods, it looked like I had to visit every bus line in Yotsuba City. when ez reWhen a cat-faced flower sprouted, this desperate thought came to my mind.
……
"carpet?"
